delivery.why: VM delivery (HBM -> VM dq) has no producer once the bands retire: every PC K port belongs to an SM group. Needs a static (compiler-windowed) K-port share or dedicated delivery PCs -- H-DIE structural item

svc.why: the 34 svc bands (and their 128 PCs) are replaced by the SM service groups + controller leaves; open/fill/read/retire/cmd are now generated INSIDE ot_hbm_svc_sm_group by ot_hbm_svc_sm_issuer (reserve/start/go) and the feed programme (read/retire); hardware-issued bench rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/run_sm_groups_issued.sh

phy.why: W loader port (w_v/w_addr/w_len/w_tag/wr_rdy) belonged to the modelled controller of ot_hbm3e_phy_v41x; the PHY-only abstract ot_hbm3e_phy_rc_e8p5 has row/column/data pins only. Host writes to HBM go through a controller K port: OPEN (host loader, H-DIE host_cp)

engine_inputs.owner: H-DIE host_cp (host loader, placeholder window): initialization tables + one launch
engine_inputs.note: clock/reset ports excluded; K ports are bound to the controller leaves; sm_packet/sm_command drive the SM

rule: bind to a real producer; never tie, stub or alias (owner 10-14 08:05)
